phrase.zh: 剪下形状，让颜色自己说话。
phrase.en: Cut a shape and let color speak.

visual.zh: 马蒂斯的生成肖像与植物般的平面色块相遇，强调剪纸的轮廓和留白。画面不是他的一幅剪纸原作，也没有宣称复原真实工作室。
visual.en: A generated Matisse portrait meets plant-like flat shapes, emphasizing cut contours and open space. This is not one of his original cut-outs or a reconstruction of his studio.

background.zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆介绍，马蒂斯从 1940 年代起用涂色纸剪出形状并重新安排组合。颜色与轮廓在这一过程中同时被确定；剪纸不是绘画完成之后的附属装饰，而能成为独立的创作方法。
background.en: MoMA describes Matisse cutting shapes from painted paper and arranging them into compositions beginning in the 1940s. Color and contour could be developed together. Cut paper became a creative method in its own right, rather than decoration added after a painting was complete.

sources.label: MoMA · Introduction to Henri Matisse: The Cut-Outs
